title: $\mathbb T$-homogeneous locally nilpotent derivations of trinomial algebras
summary: A trinomial algebra is a commutative finitely generated algebra given by a system of compatible relations each of which is a polynomial with three terms. Such algebras arise as the Cox rings of varieties admitting a complexity one torus action. We describe locally nilpotent derivations of a trinomial algebra that are homogeneous under a natural torus action of complexity one.
